_comment: CON1 Step 4 — the deterministic VISUAL QA fixture set.
One row per shape the Content Factory shell has to compose correctly. It is
a fixture of the BACKEND's answers, never a second source of truth: every
`presentation` here is a strict safe projection of the shape
`quiz.premise_projection.build_presentation` emits for that family, and
every `metadata` is the complete stored blob with its solution fields left
in — exactly as the review endpoint returns it. Nothing in the factory may
read a premise from `metadata`; these rows exist so a regression that does
is visible in a picture.
Asset paths point at the backend `assets/` tree (served locally for offline
runs), so every icon in a capture is a real file and a missing one shows.
Coverage — the ten cases Step 4 is measured against:
vq-01  short 4-option MCQ, no premise
vq-02  long prompt + long options (the readability worst case)
vq-03  2-option question (the CTA's option-count case)
vq-04  item recipe visual (missing_component)
vq-05  champion + ability cinematic band
vq-06  combat family band (post-mitigation, two champions)
vq-07  lifecycle family band (purchase/sell swap, item statuses)
vq-08  Mastery generated question (review_key + provenance, text-only)
vq-09  Daily frozen card carrying real frozen media
vq-10  a long-explanation row, for the explanation state
The reveal and explanation cases are STATES over these rows, captured with
--states question,correct,explanation.

questions.question_text: Which item grants the most armor?
questions.explanation: Thornmail grants 70 armor, the highest flat armor on any completed item.

questions.question_text: A solo laner has taken every minion since the first wave and has missed nothing. The cannon minion of wave 9 has just died to the enemy laner instead. Counting only minion gold and ignoring passive income, items, and any kill or assist gold, how far behind is the solo laner at that exact instant?
choices: About sixty gold — roughly one and a half melee minions of difference
About ninety gold — the cannon is worth close to three melee minions there
About one hundred and forty gold — the cannon plus the wave it arrived with
About two hundred gold — a full wave of minions, cannon included
questions.correct_answer: About ninety gold — the cannon is worth close to three melee minions there
questions.explanation: Cannon gold is indexed to game time rather than to wave number, and in the wave-9 window it is worth roughly ninety gold, which is close to three melee minions at their own value in that same window. Nothing else in the wave changes hands, so the whole difference is the cannon.

questions.question_text: In the World Championship on patch 4.14, which champion had the higher pick count?
questions.explanation: Kha'Zix was a contested jungle pick in that window; Janna appeared in fewer games.

questions.question_text: Which component is missing from this build path?
questions.explanation: Aether Wisp is built from Amplifying Tome and Rejuvenation Bead.

questions.question_text: Aatrox E — Umbral Dash has a rank 5 cooldown of 5 seconds. With 10 ability haste, what is its cooldown?
questions.explanation: Ability haste divides the cooldown by (1 + haste/100): 5 / 1.10 = 4.55 seconds.

questions.question_text: How much less post-mitigation damage does the hit deal after the purchase?
questions.explanation: 600 raw against 60 armor is 375 post-mitigation; against 100 armor it is 300. The purchase removes 75 damage.

questions.question_text: Ornn started with Doran's Shield and still has Sunfire Aegis. Later, Ornn sold Doran's Shield and bought Abyssal Mask. How much flat health do Ornn's items provide now?
questions.explanation: Sunfire Aegis and Abyssal Mask are the only items left; Doran's Shield left the inventory when it was sold.

questions.question_text: A 3000-damage physical hit lands on 100 armor with 18 flat armor penetration applied. What is the post-mitigation damage?
questions.explanation: Flat penetration reduces the target's armor to 82, so the multiplier is 100 / (100 + 82) = 0.549, and 3000 × 0.549 = 1786.

questions.question_text: Which item is built from this component?
questions.explanation: Serylda's Grudge builds out of Last Whisper, which itself starts from a Long Sword.

questions.question_text: Riven's Q — Broken Wings deals 15 (+45% bonus AD) physical damage per cast at rank 1. With 100 bonus attack damage, what does one cast deal before mitigation?
questions.explanation: The ratio is on BONUS attack damage, not total: 15 base plus 45% of 100 bonus AD is 60 physical damage per cast. All three casts of Broken Wings use the same values, so the full chain is 180 before mitigation — but the question asks for a single cast. Reading the ratio as total AD is the common error and would give a number roughly three times too large on a full build.
